title: Capacity
description: What one product or project runs on, every limit it can reach, how each is measured and what to do when it is crossed. Lives at capacity.json in the product's repository; AXLE's R8 → Capacity is drawn from it (axle SPEC §10.13). Vendor-neutral: any provider, any kind of infrastructure.

product.description: The product's id (antarax-api registry) or a client project's own id.

plans.description: Every provider and plan the product runs on: the plan register.

provider.description: Who runs it: a cloud, a host, REKA's own server.

service.description: What it is, in plain words: managed Postgres, object storage, serverless functions, a VM, email sending…

confirmed.description: False until someone has checked the plan in the provider's billing page. Shown as 'Not confirmed'.

cost.description: Per month, as a string with its currency: 'US$25', 'RM0'.

rules.description: The plan's own rules that can stop the product, in words: idle pause, non-commercial use only, a project count.

asset.description: The same plan as an asset in AX Frame, REKA's source of truth for what it pays for and when it renews (YaraOne docs/21): its id there, e.g. 'ast_8Kq2…'. Cost and renewal then come from Frame; capacity.json adds only the limits and how they are measured.

url.description: A page that touches the database, so a paused or broken database fails the check.

from.description: Where the check runs. Must be outside the product's own hosting.

promise.description: Uptime promised to clients, if any: '99.5%'.

name.description: In plain words: 'Database size', 'Photos and receipts'.

plan.description: The id of the plan whose limit this is.

unit.description: bytes, requests/day, requests/month, ms-p95, connections, count, emails/day, emails/month, tokens/month, money/month, minutes, percent

limit.description: The number the plan allows, in unit. null when the plan has no hard limit; then 'budget' must say what REKA allows itself.

budget.description: A limit REKA sets itself where the plan has none (pay-as-you-go), in unit.

per.description: What the limit counts over, when it resets: 'day', 'month', 'billing-cycle', 'none'.

how.description: provider-api: the provider's usage endpoint. query: the product's own query (pg_database_size, a sum of file sizes). log: counted from the product's own records. manual: read by a person from a billing page, with the date. none: not measured yet.

source.description: The endpoint, query, table or page it comes from.

why_not.description: When how is none: why, and what would measure it.

warn_at.description: Percent of the limit that warns. 80 by default; may be lower, never higher.

runway_days.description: A runway shorter than this warns. 30 by default; may be longer, never shorter.

decide.description: What to do when it crosses, in order of preference. The page says it; it never acts.

top.description: What the opened resource lists as using it: 'tables', 'buckets', 'organisations', 'routes', 'jobs'.
